chunks: Fadalah ibn Yasar, from al-Isma'il ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
'Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) used to say: 'It is that which you do not know when it will meet you; what prevents you from preparing for it before it strikes you suddenly?'
ai.seo_question: What did Jesus (Isa) say about preparing for death?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Prophet Jesus (Isa) emphasizes the unpredictability of death to urge continuous spiritual preparation, a theme central to Shia asceticism (Zuhd). This hadith underscores the ethical imperative of maintaining a state of readiness for the soul's departure, ensuring one is not caught off guard by the suddenness of the end. It serves as a practical reminder for believers to align their daily actions with eternal accountability.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 11.Faḍālah narrated from Ismāʿīl, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said,
“ʿĪsā ibn Maryam (a) used to say [regarding death], ‘A terror which youknow not when you will meet, so what prevents you from preparing for it before it comes to you suddenly?’”
